property_summary: For any caller who is Owner and any target contract with a payable fallback/receive that records whether it was paid, calling Command with some msg.value causes the target to receive that exact ETH amount (so address(c).balance decreases accordingly and the target records a nonzero received amount); the mutant that drops the value forwarding will leave the target unpaid for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Replace the call by forwarding no value (value removed), so msg.value is not forwarded to the target.
